__doc__.how: Copy this file to api-tests/<name>.json (no leading underscore) and run `npm run qa:api -- <name>.json`. Files starting with _ are treated as templates and skipped.
__doc__.placeholders: {{VAR}} resolves against variables, values captured from earlier responses, then process.env — so secrets (e.g. PASSWORD) stay out of the file.
__doc__.expect: status = exact code · maxLatencyMs = upper bound · bodyContains = substring · headers = case-insensitive substring match · json = dot-path checks where the value is 'exists' | 'array' | 'number' | 'string' | 'boolean' | 'object' | a literal to equal.
__doc__.capture: Pull a value out of the JSON response (by dot-path) into a variable reusable by later requests.
